current.text: The projected starters are Fred VanVleet, Amen Thompson, Kevin Durant, Jabari Smith Jr. and Alperen Sengun.
VanVleet is back, so Amen Thompson no longer plays point guard.
The guard rotation is crowded. VanVleet returns, and the team added Marcus Smart and Bogdan Bogdanovic.
Reed Sheppard is pushed down by the crowded guard group. Under Udoka, Amen Thompson and Marcus Smart could take most of the point guard minutes over him.
The 10-man rotation has Smart, Sheppard, Bogdanovic and Steven Adams on the bench.
With Steven Adams back, Jabari Smith Jr. plays more power forward than center.
The extra guard depth may push Durant and Tari Eason into forward roles, which concentrates the frontcourt minutes.
The roster is thin after the top 10 or 11 players.
Reports from Rockets media day say Kevin Durant will play fewer minutes.
Udoka tends to limit Sengun's minutes. Because the coach focuses on defense, other bigs sometimes play over him.
Houston is a winning team. One preview predicts 54 wins, and the win total of 47.5 ranks 9th of 30.
The team is expected to play it safe in the regular season and not chase seeding.
The fantasy playoff schedule is weak. With our March 28 end, Houston plays 3, 3 and 4 games in weeks 19 to 21, 10 in total, and has back-to-backs in weeks 20 and 21.
Houston has only 14 back-to-backs, which keeps rest risk for its players on the low side.

durable.text: Ime Udoka is a defense-first coach. He gives little room for error to players who struggle on defense.
Udoka holds grudges against some players.
Udoka plays his starters heavy minutes.
The team's identity is maximizing possessions. It limits turnovers and dominates the offensive glass to get second chances.

note: Udoka's defense-first rotation and heavy starter minutes favor Amen Thompson and the starting frontcourt. Reed Sheppard loses out in a crowded guard group with VanVleet, Smart and Bogdanovic, and Sengun and Durant both face minutes limits. The 10-game playoff schedule under our March 28 end is weak, so in the first weeks watch Durant's and Sengun's minutes and who gets the backup point guard minutes.
